reports.summary: Torrent Power is an integrated power utility initiating coverage with a Neutral rating and target price of INR1,270 (4% upside). The company operates 6.6GWp of capacity across thermal, renewable, transmission, and distribution with best-in-class AT&C losses of 2.3% in its licensed distribution business. Strong earnings visibility stems from contracted renewable capacity expansion to 6.3GWp by FY29, the recently completed Nabha thermal acquisition, and upcoming long-term growth from pumped storage and greenfield thermal projects, supporting 17% EBITDA CAGR over FY26-29E.
reports.connection_narrative: The global energy transition is driving structural demand for integrated power utilities that can blend renewable generation with dispatchable thermal capacity, a thesis directly supported by India's rapidly rising electricity consumption and grid stability requirements. Simultaneously, the weak LNG outlook with global liquefaction capacity expanding 10-11% year-over-year is poised to soften gas prices structurally from 2H CY27, reducing the economic headwinds facing gas-based generation assets. Distribution sector reforms, particularly the proposed Electricity Amendment Bill 2025 enabling multiple discoms in single areas and the upcoming privatization of UP distribution, create significant runway for operators with proven operational excellence. Torrent Power capitalizes on all three dynamics through its strategic positioning. The company's renewable portfolio is set to grow from 2.1GWp to 6.3GWp by FY29 with 4.2GWp already contracted, providing earnings certainty while reducing policy risk. Its recent acquisition of the 1.4GW Nabha thermal plant eliminates execution risk and immediately adds scale to its thermal portfolio, while long-term LNG supply agreements with Japan's JERA and BP starting 2027 ensure fuel security and position it to benefit from cheaper gas economics when prices normalize. The company's distribution business is its competitive moat: AT&C losses of only 2.3% in licensed distribution dramatically outperform peers like Tata Power and Adani Energy, reflecting superior metering, collection practices, and theft prevention, making it the most credible bidder for upcoming UP privatization packages. The planned 3GW pumped storage project and 1.6GW ultra-supercritical thermal plant in Madhya Pradesh backed by a 25-year PPA extend visibility to FY32. The single most important catalyst to watch is the commissioning of contracted renewable capacity at mid-to-high teen IRR targets and any success in winning additional distribution licenses in the UP privatization, either of which could drive significant upside to the neutral thesis. The primary risk is execution on INR377 billion capex commitments across multiple geographies and technology types, where delays or cost overruns could materially compress returns.

reports.summary: Molbio Diagnostics is initiating at Buy with a 27% upside to INR1,600 price target. The company is a high-conviction pick positioned to deliver 22% revenue and 47% PAT CAGR through FY29E via Truenat platform scale-up and commercialization of emerging Prorad and Optrascan platforms. Significant margin expansion opportunity exists as test kit capacity utilization rises and new platforms scale with structural operating leverage.
reports.connection_narrative: India's healthcare system faces a critical infrastructure challenge in reaching remote and underserved populations with accurate diagnostics, especially for infectious diseases where point-of-care testing can be transformative. Government initiatives including the expanded HPV diagnosis program and continued TB testing emphasis are creating sustained demand tailwinds for portable, battery-operated molecular diagnostics platforms that don't require complex laboratory infrastructure. This macro policy environment is structurally favorable for the next 3-5 years as India builds out primary healthcare capacity. Molbio's Truenat platform is the primary beneficiary because it directly addresses this gap: it's lighter, faster, and infrastructure-independent compared to competitors like GeneXpert while operating in an oligopolistic market with only a few true global competitors. The platform has achieved USD130 million in revenue with 12,500+ installed devices across India and emerging markets, but has massive headroom given GeneXpert's USD3 billion scale. Beyond Truenat, Molbio is diversifying through Prorad, a portable X-ray solution addressing the portability theme across diagnostic categories, and Optrascan, a digital pathology platform entering the US market where it competes directly with established global players. The specific competitive edge lies in miniaturization expertise refined over thirteen years of R&D and 191 international patents, enabling the company to bring laboratory-grade diagnostics to point-of-care settings. Financially, Molbio is at an earnings inflection point: test kit capacity utilization is rising from 58% to 77% forecast by FY29E, driving gross margin expansion, while operating leverage from new platform launches pushing recurring revenue higher will compress operating costs as a percentage of sales. The company expects PAT to triple by FY29E compared to FY26, delivering 47% earnings CAGR. The single most critical catalyst to monitor is Optrascan's adoption trajectory with major US diagnostic chains beginning in FY27, as this validates the company's ability to compete globally and materially shifts the revenue mix toward higher-margin international business away from Indian government dependence. The primary downside risk remains the concentrated revenue exposure: roughly 80% of FY26 revenue derived from B2G channels and 70% from TB testing, creating execution risk if government procurement cycles slow or testing methodologies shift unexpectedly.

reports.summary: Sambhv Steel Tubes is initiating a transformative 3.4x capacity expansion backed by INR 20.5 Bn capex through FY29E, positioning the company to capture robust 7-9% annual steel demand growth across ERW pipes, hot-rolled coils and stainless steel. With revenue expected to compound at 45% CAGR and conservative mid-level utilisation providing headroom, the integrated manufacturer's vertical integration and mix shift toward high-margin products will drive EBITDA and PAT growth at 47% CAGR, supporting ROE recovery to 25%.
reports.connection_narrative: India's government infrastructure capex is in a sustained 23.7% CAGR expansion cycle through FY26, directly pulling finished steel demand at a healthy 7.8% CAGR with projections to reach 105 MT by FY29E. This macro tailwind is particularly strong in hot-rolled steel at 7-9% growth and ERW pipes at 8.5% CAGR, which together represent India's largest structural steel segments. Additionally, the stainless steel market is accelerating to 8.2% CAGR reaching INR 1.7 trillion by FY30E, offering high-margin mix-upgrading potential as appliances, railways, metros and construction applications drive diversified demand. Sambhv Steel Tubes is uniquely positioned to capture this multi-threaded opportunity through a deliberate 3.4x capacity expansion that will lift finished-product capacity from 508 kt to 1,730 kt by FY29E. The company's strategic advantage stems from vertical integration—it controls its own hot-rolled coil production with 370 kt mild steel plus 80 kt stainless capacity—which insulates it from external supplier dependency and import-driven input cost volatility that constrains competitors like APL Apollo. The Kesda facility will anchor new seamless pipe lines earning INR 45,000 per tonne EBITDA, stainless CR coil operations at INR 17,000 per tonne, and galvalume coil capabilities at INR 5,000 per tonne, collectively lifting blended EBITDA per tonne from INR 6,901 in FY26 to INR 9,377 by FY29E. This mix shift, combined with the revenue expansion at 44.9% CAGR to INR 73.4 billion, will drive EBITDA and PAT growth at 47% CAGR each while maintaining conservative mid-level utilisation of just 49-54% in FY28E-29E, demonstrating the scalability of the asset base beyond the forecast period. The market structure itself favours Sambhv's expansion: the ERW pipe market remains over 50% fragmented with smaller players, yet Sambhv's FY29E volume projections require less than one percentage point of market share gain despite growing its ERW volumes substantially. Leverage will peak in FY27E when capex deployment is at its heaviest, then decline steadily as new asset earnings materialise and return ratios rebound sharply with ROE reaching approximately 25%. The single most critical catalyst to monitor is the on-time commissioning of the Kesda seamless pipe production lines and stainless operations in FY28E-29E, as execution delays would compress the earnings uplift. Conversely, the primary downside risk to execute flawlessly against capex timelines or unforeseen import margin pressure from global stainless steel spreads could compress near-term profitability, though the structural demand backdrop remains supportive.
